Single-binary documentation generator for markdown, HTML, OpenAPI, and Protobuf.

Running `aid` with no command prints help. Every command accepts `--help` (`-h`). `aid --version` prints the version.

## `aid init`

Scaffold a new aid project. Not implemented yet: it prints an error and exits 1.

```sh
aid init [DIR]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DIR` | positional | none | Target directory (default: current directory). |

## `aid dev`

Start the local dev server with hot reload.

```sh
aid dev [OPTIONS] [DIR]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DIR` | positional | none | Project directory (default: current directory). |
| `--file`, `-f` | string | `aid.yaml` | Config file relative to the project directory (e.g. aid.yml). |
| `--port` | string | none | Override dev server port. |
| `--host` | string | none | Override dev server host. |

## `aid build`

Build the static documentation site.

```sh
aid build [OPTIONS] [DIR]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DIR` | positional | none | Project directory (default: current directory). |
| `--file`, `-f` | string | `aid.yaml` | Config file relative to the project directory (e.g. aid.yml). |
| `--clean` | boolean | none | Delete the output directory before building. |

## `aid lint`

Run bundled linters across markdown, OpenAPI, protobuf, and Biome-supported files (JS, TS, JSON, CSS).

```sh
aid lint [OPTIONS] [DIR]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DIR` | positional | none | Project directory (default: current directory). |
| `--fix` | boolean | none | Apply autofixes where the underlying tool supports it (markdown, biome). |
| `--filter` | string | none | Comma-separated list of tools to run: md, openapi, biome, proto. |
| `--format` | one of `pretty`, `json` | `pretty` | Output format. |

## `aid fmt`

Run bundled formatters across markdown, OpenAPI, protobuf, and Biome-supported files (JS, TS, JSON, CSS).

```sh
aid fmt [OPTIONS] [DIR]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DIR` | positional | none | Project directory (default: current directory). |
| `--check` | boolean | none | Don't write changes; exit non-zero if any file would be reformatted. |
| `--filter` | string | none | Comma-separated list of tools to run: md, openapi, biome, proto. |
| `--format` | one of `pretty`, `json` | `pretty` | Output format. |

## `aid help`

Show help for a command.

```sh
aid help [COMMAND]
```

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `COMMAND` | positional | none | Command to show help for. |
